# ObanChore v0.4.0 - Table of Contents

> UI-driven operational tools for Oban workers.

## Pages

- [ObanChore 🎭](https://oban-chore.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [ObanChore](https://oban-chore.hexdocs.pm/ObanChore.md): ObanChore transforms standard Oban workers into secure, UI-driven operational tools.
- [ObanChore.Plugin](https://oban-chore.hexdocs.pm/ObanChore.Plugin.md): An Oban Plugin that automatically discovers and manages chores.
- [ObanChore.Router](https://oban-chore.hexdocs.pm/ObanChore.Router.md): Provides a macro to mount the ObanChore dashboard in your application's router.
- [ObanChore.Worker](https://oban-chore.hexdocs.pm/ObanChore.Worker.md): A macro that wraps `Oban.Worker` to provide the DSL for defining chore inputs.
